event.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Included in Portugal's Nations League Squad Under New Coach Jorge Jesus
event.canonical_title: Cristiano Ronaldo Included in Portugal's Nations League Squad Under New Coach Jorge Jesus
event.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has been named in Portugal's squad for the upcoming Nations League matches against Norway and Denmark. This selection marks the first squad announced by new head coach Jorge Jesus since the World Cup.

timeline.title: Ireland Coach Discusses Uncertainty Ahead of Match Against Israel
timeline.summary: Heimir Hallgrimsson, the coach of the Republic of Ireland, stated that the team has not yet decided on their approach for the upcoming Nations League match against Israel, which will be played behind closed doors in Serbia. This uncertainty comes amid concerns from some players regarding the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
key_facts: Ireland's coach Heimir Hallgrimsson expressed uncertainty about the team's approach for the match against Israel.
The match is set to take place behind closed doors in Serbia.
Some players have voiced unease regarding the situation in Gaza.
